envelope.description: Add optional additive followOn field to ApproveWorkflowTargetResult

body.title: Add optional additive followOn field to ApproveWorkflowTargetResult
body.summary: Extend the ApproveWorkflowTargetResult type in src/workflow/gates.ts with an optional `followOn?: FollowOnOutcome[]` where FollowOnOutcome = { kind: 'bugfix-advance' | 'bugfix-complete'; artifactPath: string; ok: boolean; note?: string }. Additive + optional so every existing caller compiles unchanged. No behaviour change in this task.
acceptanceChecks: ApproveWorkflowTargetResult has an optional followOn field typed as the FollowOnOutcome[] union described.
tsc --noEmit passes with no changes required at any existing call site (daemon/index.ts:610, mcp/server.ts:853, gate tests).

tests.name: existing gate callers + tests compile with the optional followOn field (tsc --noEmit gate)
